description: Add a saved reply, or change one (saved_reply_id; fields left out stay as they are). {name} in the text becomes the person's username. Keywords make it the suggested answer under new comments that mention one; shortcut lets a person type /shortcut in a reply box. Keep it short and in the brand's voice. Saving keeps the suggested library first if nothing was kept yet.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

keywords.description: Words or emoji that make it the suggested answer, matched whole ignoring case and accents, plurals either way. [] stops suggesting it

saved_reply_id.description: The one to change (from saved_replies_list); omit to add one

text.description: Required when adding. Up to 1,000 characters, so it also fits an Instagram DM

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: saved_reply_save
title: Save a reply
